- Led weekly project-based classes, covering topics ranging from programming fundamentals to game development, in languages including Python, Scratch, Java, and more.
- Developed lesson plans and projects tailored to each student's interests and goals, ensuring steady progress over several months.
- Strengthened soft skills including professional communication, constructive feedback, and conflict resolution.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Collaborated on a new Hardware Abstraction Layer (HAL) being developed for Arista’s next generation platforms, allowing engineers to write device-independent software, maintaining high performance
regardless of the type of underlying ASIC performing the low-level operations.
- Led design and development of the HAL component responsible for managing the connection between software tables and hardware tables, allowing feature agents to organize and access data in an intuitive and flexible manner, translating those changes seamlessly into rigid hardware tables with strict APIs.
- Delivered a novel innovation to a widely used data structure, resulting in 50% lower memory usage as
well as 200% faster execution time for all instances of the data structure across the company code-base.
- Complemented all product code developed in C++ by writing a full suite of automated tests in Python,
including unit tests, performance tests, integration tests, and end-to-end tests.

projects.title: Scheduler Backend for theCoderSchool
projects.description:
- Redesigned and developed a backend for theCoderSchool's company scheduling system, written in Java using Spring Boot, with a PostgreSQL database.
- Retrieved real-world company data from the Pike13 API, then used Jackson to decompose the nested JSON into a number of relational tables.
- Assembled data missing from Pike13 by using JSoup to parse and scrape student portal webpages from theCoderSchool website.
- Designed to efficiently send hundreds of HTTP requests asynchronously, process futures, parse and scrape results, and store data all within 1-2 seconds.
- Implemented a RESTful API with endpoints to enable serving data from the database to the frontend.

projects.title: Bank Account Management System
projects.description:
(Group Project)
- Designed and built a database for managing information on bank customers, accounts, and transactions in Java, using the JDBC interface to write SQL and perform queries to the Oracle DBMS.
- Implemented an ATM interface for customers to perform account transactions, and a Bank Teller interface for employees to manage accounts, e.g. accrue interest or generate monthly reports
- Performed extensive relational database design in order to handle 20+ different kinds of transactions over three types of accounts, each with dozens of integrity constraints, and ensure a consistent and efficient database.
- Developed proficiency in SQL, relational algebra and calculus, relational database design, ER models, FDs and decomposition into BCNF.
